title: One night of Jeeve learning
subtitle: 138 unattended runs. Each failure was traced to a gap in what it sees, searches or remembers, and fixed in the harness. 125 passed, 58 of the last 59.

title: Run 1: from nothing
subtitle: Four trees with leaves out of reach. Jeeve has never pillared, so the builder writes the skill in 3 tries. 7 minutes.

title: Run 1: crafting breaks
subtitle: Back-to-back crafts read a stale inventory: planks became buttons and crafts hung. The wood ran out, and Jeeve gave up.

title: Round 4: Jeeve dies on guard duty
subtitle: It flips between two zombies every half second, so no swing lands. Fixed with a short dwell before switching targets.

title: Round 4: skills kept, no restarts
subtitle: The pillaring skill from round 1 is reused, and the fast model stops restarting it mid-climb. Four trees in 2:22.

title: New layouts: learning again
subtitle: A random scene with 5 trees, an empty library and no free blocks. A new skill in 2 tries, and every tree cleared.

title: Search: trees out of sight
subtitle: Every tree starts 40–60 blocks away, beyond what Jeeve can see. It searches outward from where it started, and gets its 16 logs in under 3 minutes.

title: Final: a new layout, learned skills
subtitle: Random trees, oak and birch, and no free blocks. One tree at a time, with the pillaring skill it learned and no scaffolding left behind. 2:41.

title: Final: the workshop in 45 seconds
subtitle: Crafting and chest skills from earlier runs, reused: logs, planks, a crafting table, the tool, the chest.

title: Final: guard duty
subtitle: Zombie waves at night. Whoever hits Josh is marked for the fast model, and Josh and Jeeve both make it.
